key: 保障/補償/保証 (再掲注意)

WRONG READING-SET. 成句 ('set phrase/idiom') reads せいく, not せいか — the kanji 句 is on-yomi く (cf. 俳句 はいく, 慣用句 かんようく, 故事成句 こじせいく), never か. The gloss itself is correct, but the entry mis-assigns it to the せいか homophone set. This is the confident-but-wrong reading error class. Removed from the confirmed せいか set.

FABRICATED/NON-STANDARD ENTRY. '欠かん' is not standard orthography for any けっかん noun. Its own gloss cross-references 欠員 ('vacancy of a post'), but 欠員 reads けつ-いん (員=いん), so it is not a けっかん homophone at all — the cross-reference is broken. The entry self-flags ('rare','avoid','drop the rare third'). Real additional けっかん homophones would be 欠刊 (suspension of publication) or 欠巻 (missing volume), not this. Removed from the confirmed けっかん set.

key: ついか / おいか (追加 / 付加)
issue: Fails its own ASR-homophone premise: 追加 is read ついか, but 付加 is read ふか — they are NOT homophones, so this is not a transcription-confusion pair at all. The key's 'おいか' is not a valid reading of any word here (likely fabricated). The note text is also garbled ('追加 (tsuika) ... similarly-shaped 追加 vs 付加'). Reject — the entry's central claim (acoustic confusion of these two readings) is false.
